content: इन्द्राणी [इन्द्रस्य पत्नी आनुक् डीप् <ls>P. IV. 1. 49.</ls>] .²1 The wife of Indra; आजगाम सहेन्द्राण्या शकः सुरगणैर्वृतः <ls>Mb. 3. 14. 13</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā, considered as one of the eight mothers or divine energies. .²3 A kind of coitus. .²4 Large cardamoms. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree (नीलसिंदुवार); also the plant निर्गुंडी.
